Subject: Onboarding: Chile RUT, VAT treatment & PO currency for AndesCloud

Hi Carlos / AndesCloud AP team —

Thanks again for confirming the pilot scope. To get your vendor record live in our system and issue a first PO we need a few items from you:

- Legal name and RUT (tax ID) as shown on your tax certificate
- Confirmation whether AndesCloud will charge IVA (19%) on invoices to Redwood and whether you expect any local withholding to apply
- Preferred invoice currency (CLP or USD) and bank details for wire/payment (please specify whether the account accepts USD inbound)
- A sample invoice (PDF or XML) so our AP team can map invoice fields to our PO/invoice matcher

I've attached our vendor_onboarding_form.pdf — please complete pages 1–2 and return. If you can also attach a copy of your RUT certificate and a sample invoice it will help speed invoice matching.

Goal: create PO and enable first payment in Jan. Can you send the docs by EOD Tuesday, Jan 20?

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable), onboarding checklist
From: Carlos Rojas <c.rojas@andescloud.cl>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: ap@andescloud.cl, sofia.alvarez@andescloud.cl
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 10:46:00 -0300
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Chile RUT, VAT treatment & PO currency for AndesCloud

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear list. Please find answers below and attached samples.

- Legal name: AndesCloud SpA
- RUT: 76.543.210-9 (certificate attached as rut_certificate.pdf)
- VAT: AndesCloud is VAT-registered and will charge IVA at 19% on local sales. For services provided to a foreign entity, Chilean VAT rules can be nuanced — since AndesCloud is a Chile resident supplier invoicing a US buyer for cloud professional services, we will include IVA 19% on invoices unless Redwood provides an applicable exemption. We are not currently applying reverse-charge on our customers (no mechanism on our side to flip VAT).
- Withholding: not applicable for invoices billed in CLP; if an invoice has a foreign-sourced component there are sometimes withholding obligations but not in our typical SaaS/professional services case.
- Preferred currency: we can invoice in CLP or USD. We prefer CLP for domestic bank accounts but can accept USD in our USD bank (see bank details in sample invoice).

Attached: sample_invoice_CLI-789.xml (fields included), rut_certificate.pdf.

If Redwood prefers us to invoice USD and treat VAT differently, let us know and we can coordinate with our accountant.

Best,
Carlos Rojas
Finance Lead — AndesCloud SpA
c.rojas@andescloud.cl
Attachments: sample_invoice_CLI-789.xml, rut_certificate.pdf

Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding: Chile RUT, VAT treatment & PO currency for AndesCloud

Thanks for the forward — quick notes from AP and tax mapping perspective: 

- We should ask AndesCloud to invoice in the currency they prefer; Redwood will create the PO in the invoice currency to avoid FX reconciliation on first payment. If they invoice in CLP we'll create PO in CLP and add a tax line: CL-IVA19 (tax amount will be separate from the net service amount).
- Required docs: please upload rut_certificate.pdf to vendor file cabinet and attach the completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf before first payment. AP cannot process payments without a tax ID file in the system.
- If AndesCloud invoices in USD but still charges IVA, AP will accept the USD invoice but we must capture the IVA value and code it to CL-IVA19 with the CLP equivalent recorded for tax reporting. We will rely on vendor-provided VAT amount and supporting sample invoice.
- Withholding: based on Karthik's initial flags, no Chilean withholding for this typical SaaS consulting flow. If tax has change, Karthik will advise.

Next steps: Monica please confirm PO currency preference with vendor (CLP preferred by AndesCloud) and confirm when we have completed onboarding_form + rut_certificate uploaded. I'll draft PO-ANDESCLOUD-000123 (see attached PO stub).

Laura Bennett
AP Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Attachments: PO-ANDESCLOUD-000123.pdf (draft)
